record_contract.unit: one whole target assistant turn per record
record_contract.target_rule: one category for the entire observed target turn; mixed-category, malformed, ambiguous, or unresolved turns are excluded by the accepted converter

training.partial_final_accumulation: at each epoch boundary, scale the final short window by its actual record count and update before changing sigma
training.parameter_grouping: all names containing encoder. at encoder LR; all other named parameters at nonencoder LR
training.action_objective: loss_rlcd(choice_logits[6]) + 1.0 * cross_entropy(choice_logits[6], one_hot_gold); ancillary binary act_head is excluded
training.shuffle: random.Random(seed + epoch).shuffle over accepted manifest order
training.checkpoint_candidates: one exact-reload checkpoint per completed seed; no test access
training.selection: highest dev macro_f1, then lowest dev nll, then lowest declared seed

budget.fallback_rule: before any main run, use measured smoke timing to project both complete seeds; use only seed 42 iff the recorded conservative projection exceeds 7200 aggregate GPU-seconds

evaluation.nll_floor_semantics: numerical clipping only; no additive smoothing, fitting, or calibration
evaluation.probabilities: raw softmax in fixed label order
evaluation.final_test_policy: after a dev-only freeze, one atomic test-attempt marker is created before test rows or predictions are opened; no retry
evaluation.held_out_claim: exploratory held-out evidence because the split was previously inspected

latency.unit: one entire record containing the single next_action question
latency.warm_definition: CUDA synchronize; tokenize/build, collate, host-to-device copy, forward, raw softmax and CPU probability copy; CUDA synchronize
latency.cold_load_definition: process-local timer immediately before local config/tokenizer/model construction through strict weights load, device transfer, eval mode and first CUDA synchronize
latency.training_definition: first training microforward through final optimizer update and CUDA synchronize

checkpoint.reload: strict model load, bit-exact model state digest, and exact optimizer/scheduler/scaler/stopping-state comparison before dev evaluation

baselines.transition: rendered-state-only previous-action cue with declared initial fallback
baselines.tfidf_logistic: TF-IDF on exact rendered state plus question; dev budget frozen before test
baselines.primary_comparator: highest dev macro_f1, then lowest dev nll, then lexical method name
